title: Application updates
confirmHint: Install version {{version}} and restart? This stops all forwards and host tests.

phase.ready: Update verified and ready to install.
phase.error: The update could not be completed.

unavailable.notConfigured: In-app updates are not enabled for this build. Download an installer from Releases.
unavailable.development: Updates are disabled in development builds.
unavailable.unsupported: Use an installed version to update this app.
unavailable.browser: Open the desktop app to check for updates.

errors.check: Could not check for updates. Check your network or visit Releases.
errors.download: Download or signature verification failed. Download the update again.
errors.install: Could not start or complete installation. Check that the app is in a writable installation folder, retry, or download an installer.
errors.cleanup: Session cleanup failed. Installation was canceled.
errors.activityChanged: Active sessions changed. Review them and confirm installation again.
errors.preferences: Could not read or save the startup check preference. Change the switch to retry saving.
errors.busy: Another update operation is running. Try again when it finishes.
errors.notReady: The selected update is no longer ready. Check or download it again.
errors.unavailable: Updates are unavailable for this build.
errors.request: Could not communicate with the updater. Try again or restart the app.
